sentences.en: She has diabetes and so they chopped off her feet.
sentences.zh: 她患有糖尿病，因此他们切掉了她的脚。

sentences.en: The children danced around me and chanted, "Diabetes, diabetes, diabetes!"
sentences.zh: 孩子们围着我跳舞并喊着，“糖尿病，糖尿病，糖尿病！”

sentences.en: You better not eat that pear if you have diabetes.
sentences.zh: 如果你有糖尿病的话，最好不要吃那个梨。
